title: Part Five: The Split and the Separation

sections.brief: 2006–2007: the boycott, the US plan reported by Vanity Fair, the battle of June 2007; no elections since; 2021 postponement. Figure: time.
Israel's separation of Gaza from the West Bank since 1991: permits, Oslo's 'single territorial unit', the figures; Israel's security case. Figure: stats.
The Qatari money 2018–2023; what Netanyahu and others said, his denials, Qatar's account, the Shin Bet findings. Figure: compare.
Would Hamas be what it is without the split and the separation? Two readings, labelled as argument; what the record can and cannot settle. Figure: flow.
